name: nzbgetvpn
description: NZBGet is a cross-platform binary newsgrabber for nzb files, written in C++. It supports client/server mode, automatic par-check/-repair, web-interface, command-line interface, etc. NZBGet requires low system resources and runs great on routers, NAS-devices and media players. This Docker includes OpenVPN to ensure a secure and private connection to the Internet
